name: ward-ground-raycast
js: (()=>{const a=window.__CITY_APP,T=window.CITY.THREE; a.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[1720,70,2470],look:[1700,0,2300],fov:60});const rays=[];for(const [x,z]of[[1700,2200],[1750,2250],[1800,2200],[1800,2100],[1600,2250]]){const r=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(x,80,z),new T.Vector3(0,-1,0));rays.push({x,z,hits:r.intersectObjects(a.scene.children,true).filter(h=>h.point.y<5).slice(0,12).map(h=>{const o=h.object;let p=o;const parents=[];while(p){parents.push(p.name||p.type);p=p.parent;}return{y:h.point.y,name:o.name,parents,material:Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material.map(m=>m.name):o.material?.name,userData:o.material?.userData}})});}return rays;})()
